candidates.text: Arya shares a fireside meal and drink with a group of young Lannister soldiers in the Riverlands.
candidates.grounded_in: In the Riverlands, Arya meets some friendly Lannister soldiers

candidates.text: At the Citadel, Sam quietly helps himself to books from the restricted section of the library.
candidates.grounded_in: At the Citadel, Samwell "borrows" restricted library books

candidates.text: Edd opens the gate at Castle Black to receive Bran and Meera, arrived out of the snow.
candidates.grounded_in: Edd receives Bran and Meera at Castle Black

candidates.text: In Winterfell's hall, Sansa contradicts Jon in front of everyone over the young Umber and Karstark heirs.
candidates.grounded_in: At Winterfell, Sansa objects when Jon accepts the loyalties of Houses Umber and Karstark

candidates.text: Euron sails into King's Landing and offers Cersei his Iron Fleet along with a marriage proposal.
candidates.grounded_in: Euron arrives to propose marriage in exchange for his Iron Fleet

candidates.text: At a roadside inn, Arya is served stew by an old friend from her travels who bakes bread.
candidates.grounded_in: Arya is reunited with Hot Pie

candidates.text: By candlelight in a quarantine cell, Sam peels and scrapes the greyscale crust from Jorah's chest and arm.
candidates.grounded_in: Sam performs a forbidden surgery on Jorah's greyscale infection

candidates.text: Daenerys presses Varys about the many masters he has served, and he answers her before the whole room.
candidates.grounded_in: Daenerys challenges Varys' loyalty

candidates.text: Daenerys and her assembled allies plan their campaign standing around the great carved map table at Dragonstone.
candidates.grounded_in: Daenerys heeds Tyrion's advice not to take King's Landing by force

candidates.text: Before sailing south and leaving Winterfell in Sansa's charge, Jon warns Littlefinger never to touch her.
candidates.grounded_in: He warns Littlefinger to never touch Sansa

candidates.text: At the Citadel, Sam is set to copying out stacks of old texts as punishment for his disobedience.
candidates.grounded_in: makes him copy old texts for his disobedience

candidates.text: Melisandre keeps out of sight when Jon arrives, then tells Varys she is sailing for Volantis.
candidates.grounded_in: Melisandre avoids Jon and departs for Volantis, telling Varys she will return to Westeros

candidates.text: Meera wheels Bran through the gates of Winterfell, where Sansa finds his manner strangely distant.
candidates.grounded_in: Bran, with Meera, arrives at Winterfell and reveals his new Three-Eyed Raven identity to Sansa

candidates.text: Jon and Davos give up their weapons on the shore below Dragonstone before climbing to the castle.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon arrives at Dragonstone.

candidates.text: Euron delivers his promised gift to Cersei in the throne room and is made commander of her navy.
candidates.grounded_in: Euron presents Ellaria and Tyene as gifts to Cersei ... She makes him commander of her navy.

candidates.text: Deep in a dragonglass cave, Jon lifts a torch to show Daenerys ancient spiral carvings left by the Children of the Forest.
candidates.grounded_in: In a cave filled with dragonglass, Jon reveals ancient wall paintings to Daenerys depicting the First Men and the Children of the Forest joining forces against the undead.

candidates.text: In the Winterfell courtyard, Arya and Brienne spar with blunted weapons while Sansa watches, astonished, from the walkway above.
candidates.grounded_in: Arya spars with Brienne, impressing her and amazing Sansa with her exceptional fighting skills

candidates.text: Cersei receives a banker from Braavos and assures him the crown's enormous debt will soon be repaid in full.
candidates.grounded_in: Cersei assures the Iron Bank full repayment of the Lannister's debt

candidates.text: Meera prepares for the journey home, and Bran's farewell to her is flat and strangely unfeeling.
candidates.grounded_in: Bran bids a homeward-bound Meera an unemotional farewell, explaining he is no longer Bran

candidates.text: Littlefinger presents Bran with a slim Valyrian steel dagger with a dragonbone hilt as a gift.
candidates.grounded_in: Littlefinger presents Bran with the Valyrian steel dagger his would-be assassin used

candidates.text: Davos smuggles Tyrion into King's Landing by boat at night, landing quietly beneath the city walls.
candidates.grounded_in: Davos smuggles Tyrion inside King's Landing

candidates.text: Fed up with the Citadel, Sam packs several restricted books and leaves Oldtown with Gilly and Little Sam.
candidates.grounded_in: Sam, frustrated, leaves the Citadel with Gilly and Little Sam, taking several restricted books with him

candidates.text: Jorah arrives at Dragonstone and presents himself once more before Daenerys, fully recovered.
candidates.grounded_in: Jorah is reunited with Daenerys at Dragonstone

candidates.text: Still soaked and battered from the river, Jaime and Bronn make their way back to King's Landing.
candidates.grounded_in: Jaime and Bronn return to King's Landing

candidates.text: Jon's ragged band trudges through deep snow far beyond the Wall, hunting a single wight as proof.
candidates.grounded_in: Beyond the Wall, Jon and the men hunt for a wight to prove the White Walkers' existence

candidates.text: At Dragonstone, Tyrion counsels Daenerys about how to handle the coming negotiations with Cersei.
candidates.grounded_in: Tyrion counsels Daenerys about the upcoming negotiations with Cersei

candidates.text: Around Winterfell, Littlefinger quietly works to leave Sansa isolated, and the sisters circle each other coldly.
candidates.grounded_in: At Winterfell, Littlefinger schemes to isolate Sansa.

7.title: The Dragon and the Wolf

candidates.text: The rival camps gather for a parley in a ruined pit on the edge of King's Landing.
candidates.grounded_in: The wight is presented to the Lannister court.

candidates.text: Tyrion walks alone through the Red Keep to speak privately with his sister.
candidates.grounded_in: Tyrion meets with Cersei

candidates.text: On the shore at Dragonstone, Theon stands before the last of his ironborn men.
candidates.grounded_in: At Dragonstone, Theon wins his men's respect

7.note: Most of this episode's memorable beats are turning points (the parley's outcome, the Winterfell trial, the Wall, the parentage reveal), so safe texture is limited.
